tells.1: Bolded-style 'Label: explanation' pattern on every bullet, even without the bold formatting
tells.2: Heavy formatting: bold title, italic date, and a bold inline label on every bullet
tells.3: Bold inline-header bullets ('**Faster bank feed sync:**') applied uniformly to a three-item list

reason: Version 4 reads like a person writing a short changelog: plain headers, direct sentences and the conventional 'Fixed a bug where…' phrasing, without the bold-label-colon scaffolding. With only three items, the labels add structure without making the notes easier to scan.
